attributes.title: ISSTD 44th Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: International Society for the Study of Trauma and Dissociation
attributes.organizer: International Society for the Study of Trauma and Dissociation
attributes.summary:
ISSTD's 44th Annual Conference moves to a four-day format: a pre-conference day on March 4, 2027, followed by the main conference from March 5 to 7 at the Hilton Boston Park Plaza. The theme is "Beacons of Hope: Lighting the Way to Connection and Courage." Registration is open and the preliminary program is published.

For professional members the three-day rate is $589 until December 15, 2026, $689 until January 31, 2027 and $739 after that. Non-members pay $689, $789 and $839, and one-day and student options are cheaper. CE and CME credits cost extra and must be bought in advance.

ISSTD is approved by the APA to sponsor CE for psychologists and is an ASWB ACE provider (#1744) for social workers. CME for physicians is also offered. Credit requires live attendance for the full session, and evaluations close on May 30, 2027. The conference hotel rate is $249 per night.
